Values._comment_credential: LOCAL DEV ONLY. The Functions HOST authenticates to the identity-based storage connection (OrigenateStorage, used by the blob & queue triggers) in its own process and CANNOT use the interactive browser — only non-interactive developer credentials (Visual Studio sign-in, Azure PowerShell, az login). AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS=dev limits DefaultAzureCredential to those and skips the Managed Identity / IMDS probe that fails 'Identity not found' on a box with no assigned identity. Not set in Azure, where the Function App's Managed Identity is used.
Values._comment_storage: TWO connections. AzureWebJobsStorage = Functions HOST plumbing ONLY (blob-trigger receipts + internal control queues + host leases). Locally use the Azurite emulator (UseDevelopmentStorage=true); in Azure point it at the Function App's DEFAULT storage account (connection string is fine). The blob trigger's heavy bookkeeping ALWAYS uses AzureWebJobsStorage, so the elevated roles (Storage Account Contributor + Storage Blob Data Owner) land on THAT account. OrigenateStorage = the DATA account: blob-trigger source (originate-landing), app BlobServiceClient/QueueServiceClient, and the dead-letter queue (producer + QueueTrigger consumer). Identity-based via DefaultAzureCredential; the account needs ONLY Storage Blob Data Contributor + Storage Queue Data Contributor. Requires Azurite running locally. Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in real values — local.settings.json is gitignored.
